question.Text: For Marlin database 6 in production window M31, do the final reports establish that migration is ready, and exactly when and to what version should we roll back?

Assets.Content:
Birch exporter 7 readiness packet, revision 1, applies to production window B09 and contains the transport check and rollback procedure only.
Birch exporter 7 production window B09 retention approval: no signed data-retention approval or rejection is recorded in this packet. The packet does not establish whether retention was approved.
Birch exporter 7 production window B09 rollback: restore exporter 6 if delivery failures exceed 2 percent for eight consecutive minutes.

Cedar agent 3.2 rollout record, revision 1, applies to the production Linux fleet in change window C17.
Cedar agent 3.2 production Linux compatibility: hosts running kernel 6.1 or newer are supported; hosts running kernel 5.15 are unsupported.
Cedar agent 3.2 production Linux rollback: retain agent 3.1 and restore it if the agent error rate exceeds 2 percent for five consecutive minutes.

Heron cache 4 window H18 has two final canary reports with equal authority, both revision 1 and both about the same production pool. Neither supersedes the other; no resolution is recorded.
Heron cache 4 production window H18 canary readiness, service final report: the canary passed and expansion is ready.
Heron cache 4 production window H18 canary readiness, reliability final report: the canary failed and expansion is not ready.
Heron cache 4 production window H18 rollback: both teams agree to restore cache 3 if cache errors exceed 5 percent for two consecutive minutes.

Larch index 5 readiness packet, revision 1, applies to production window L24 and contains the compatibility check and rollback procedure only.
Larch index 5 production window L24 security approval: no signed security approval or rejection is recorded in this packet. The packet does not establish whether security approved the change.
Larch index 5 production window L24 rollback: restore the index 4 snapshot if query failures exceed 1 percent for three consecutive minutes.

Maple ingestion 2.4 readiness record, revision 1, applies to the production standard profile in window P12.
Maple ingestion 2.4 production standard profile compatibility and rollback: schema version 4 is supported and schema version 3 is unsupported; restore ingestion 2.3 if rejected records exceed 3 percent for four consecutive minutes.

Marlin database 6 window M31 has two final readiness reports with equal authority, both revision 1 and both about the same production cluster. Neither supersedes the other; no resolution is recorded.
Marlin database 6 production window M31 migration readiness, operations final report: migration validation passed and the migration is ready.
Marlin database 6 production window M31 migration readiness, database final report: migration validation failed and the migration is not ready.
Marlin database 6 production window M31 rollback: both teams agree to restore the database 5 snapshot if replication lag exceeds 45 seconds for five consecutive minutes.

Quartz gateway 8 rollout record, revision 1, covers the east and west production regions; neither region is the default.
Quartz gateway 8 production concurrency limit: the east region allows 120 concurrent requests per instance; the west region allows 80 concurrent requests per instance. A region must be specified to select one limit.
Quartz gateway 8 production rollback: in both east and west regions, restore gateway 7 if p95 latency exceeds 300 milliseconds for ten consecutive minutes.

Saffron worker 9 readiness record, revision 1, defines production fast and bulk profiles; neither profile is the default.
Saffron worker 9 production queue limit: the fast profile allows 400 queued jobs; the bulk profile allows 900 queued jobs. A profile must be specified to select one limit.
Saffron worker 9 production rollback: for either fast or bulk, restore worker 8 if job failures exceed 4 percent for six consecutive minutes.
